title: fix(types): drop the page view-data check objectstack main deleted (objectui#12666)
body:
Fixes #12666
Clause-②: yes — dropping the attachment widens what `PageNodeSchema` / `PageKindNodeSchema` (and `safeValidateSchema`) accept: a view-data block under `slots` naming the retired `api` provider now passes, as objectstack `main`'s own `PageSchema` passes it (objectstack#23784's PR states the same Clause-②: yes for the spec). A contract-tier review is owed before the queue.

The objectui half of objectstack-ai/objectstack#23908. objectstack PR #23784 (`a35f7a6764`) deleted `checkPageComponentViewData` from `@objectstack/spec/ui`: "the component-props rule is the one judge of a page component's retired api data binding". `packages/types/src/zod/layout.zod.ts` imported and attached it, so objectstack's console build against its own spec tree failed with `MISSING_EXPORT`.

## What changes

- `layout.zod.ts`: the import and both `.superRefine` attachments (`PageNodeSchema`, `PageKindNodeSchema`) are gone; the comments that counted the attached checks now say four, and say why the judge left.
- `imported-defaults-8317.test.ts`: the symbol leaves the import and `REFINEMENT_EXCEPTIONS` (no mirror reads it any more, so the guarded exception is gone with it).
- `spec-object-refinements-7715.test.ts`: the `objectui#12370` describe block is replaced by the new pin file; the page site's `attached` list drops the name. The census still has to count the judge, because the installed `18.0.0-next.2` still exports it and still attaches it to `PageSchema`. It finds it by what it judges (`specChecksRemovedOnMain`: an unnamed exported check that refuses a slotted `object-grid` naming `api` at `properties.data.provider`), so the census is right on next.2 (1) and on a spec without the judge (0) and needs no edit at the next bump. Any other unnamed check still reddens it, by name.
- New `page-component-view-data-12666.test.ts` pins what the page doors answer now (`PageNodeSchema`, `safeValidateSchema` for a `page` node and a `home` kind node):
  - slotted `object-grid` / `object-map` / `object-gantt` / `object-tree` naming `api`: accepted (the widening);
  - the same under `regions`: still refused by the `object-grid` / `-map` / `-gantt` arms themselves, with a nested issue at `properties.data.provider`;
  - controls: an `object` binding passes in a slot (all four) and in a region (the three bag arms).
- `.changeset/12666-drop-page-component-viewdata.md`: `@object-ui/types: patch`.

## Why nothing replaces the attachment (A1 measured false)

The replacement the spec names is `validateComponentProps`, which lives in `@objectstack/lint` (`packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.ts` on objectstack `main`), not in `@objectstack/spec`. It is a lint function over a whole stack, not a Zod refinement, and the installed next.2 exports no such symbol from `@objectstack/spec/ui` (it appears there only in prose). So by the ruling the attachment is dropped and the new accept set is pinned. The upstream PR's own door table says the spec doors now accept the binding: "`PageSchema.safeParse` / `definePage` / `defineStack` ... accepted: these doors run no lint rule". The platform refuses it at save, `os validate` and `os build`.

## Imports checked on both trees

Every symbol `layout.zod.ts` still imports from `@objectstack/spec/ui` (`PageSchema`, `PageTypeSchema`, `PageVariableSchema`, `checkPageDefaultPlacement`, `checkPageRegionPlacement`, `checkPageRequiresKind`, `checkPageSlotPair`, `checkPageSourceCompleteness`) is declared in `packages/spec/src/ui/page.zod.ts` on objectstack `main` `abb6df0e01` (barrel `export * from './page.zod'`) and named in the installed next.2 `dist/ui/index.d.ts`. `git grep checkPageComponentViewData` over this branch: 0 hits (control `checkPageRegionPlacement` under `packages/types/src`: 8).

## Build proof (Done-when 3)

objectstack `main` `abb6df0e01` in a scratch worktree, `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/spec` (dist has 0 `checkPageComponentViewData`, 3 `checkPageRegionPlacement`). Then, in this branch's worktree, the steps of objectstack `scripts/build-console.sh`: `turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/console^...` (34/34 tasks), then `OBJECTSTACK_SPEC_DIST=... pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run build`.

- head `0d8acdea51a3b16782d5ff0c2df6502f4771a237`: exit 0, 0 `MISSING_EXPORT`, log echoes the injected `OBJECTSTACK_SPEC_DIST`.
- control, `layout.zod.ts` restored from base `4be76e030` and `@object-ui/types` rebuilt: exit 1, `[MISSING_EXPORT] "checkPageComponentViewData" is not exported by ".../packages/spec/dist/ui/index.mjs"`, the objectstack#23885 failure. Restored with `git checkout HEAD --`, HEAD blob hash matched, types rebuilt and the head build re-run green.
- Not run: the client injection (`OBJECTSTACK_CLIENT_DIST`) and the single-zod canary of the full script; neither reads this change.

## Reverse verification

Base `layout.zod.ts` restored over the committed fix: the new pin file's four slot cases and the census's detach case go red (5 failed / 38 passed); restored (`git diff HEAD` empty, hash match).

## Gates (local, at `0d8acdea5`)

- `vitest run --maxWorkers=1 packages/types/`: 384 files, 10354 tests passed. Touched/new files: 316 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types type-check` (includes `tsconfig.test.json`, which includes `src/**/*.test.ts`): exit 0. The `^...` closure has no build script.
- eslint `--no-inline-config` on the 4 changed `.ts` files: 4 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Root `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware and this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- exit 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check-changeset-presence.mjs`.
- `check:spec-floors`: exit 1, NOT MEASURED: 22 `[no-artifact]` findings (packages without build output in this worktree), not about this diff.

## Acceptance notes

- The `object-tree` arm does not read a region component's `properties` bag: `{ type: 'object-tree', properties: { objectName, data } }` in a region is refused with `RECORD_SOURCE_REQUIRED` whatever `data` says. That answer did not move here (the spec's object-level check never ran once a region child failed), so the pin has no tree region leg. Observation only, no public-door reach measured; carrier: none.
